title: minimax-theorem-lean
summary: A Lean formalization of von Neumann's 1928 finite two-player zero-sum minimax theorem, a foundation of modern game theory and a cornerstone of mathematical economics. Nash equilibrium existence builds directly on its mixed-strategy solution concept by extending equilibrium existence beyond the two-player zero-sum case; this is historical motivation, not a claimed Lean proof of Nash's theorem. The formal result is Minimax.minimax_theorem {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (u : A → B → ℝ) : maxminValue u = minmaxValue u.
